patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a maximum width, allowing for full-width background elements like the hero gradient.
Key words within prominent headings are highlighted with distinct, vibrant colors, creating visual emphasis and a playful tone.
A soft, multi-color gradient background is used in the hero section, providing a dynamic and modern backdrop for the content.
Multiple card-like elements appear to float and subtly parallax around the hero text, animating into view as the page loads or scrolls.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the initial hero content, gaining a solid white background and a subtle shadow.
An accordion-style FAQ section is used to present a large amount of information concisely, with clear expand/collapse indicators.

technique_notes: The hero section features a dynamic background gradient that subtly shifts, combined with multiple layered, floating card elements that animate into their initial positions and subtly parallax as the user scrolls past the hero, creating depth and visual interest.

A primary navigation bar transitions from being part of the initial page flow to a fixed, sticky element at the top of the viewport with a solid background and a subtle shadow once the user scrolls beyond the hero content.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a simple fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, guiding the user's attention down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings with multi-colored word emphasis, complemented by clear and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card elements, contributing to a soft and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced density in subsequent content blocks with generous vertical separation between sections.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the vibrant, multi-colored hero text combined with the dynamic, layered floating cards that animate and subtly parallax against a shifting gradient background. This creates a highly engaging and modern first impression that feels interactive and fresh.
